units.source_text: 这回走过他身边，她那空着的手像要胳肢他一下似的，伸到他的侧腹来。

en.t: This time, as she passed beside him, her free hand reached toward his side as if she meant to tickle him.

units.source_text: 他一惊，急忙闪开，差一点把油灯给弄掉地下。

en.t: Startled, he hurriedly dodged away and nearly dropped the oil lamp on the ground.

units.source_text: 他拿不定主意，就这样继续拿着灯呢，还是把它放到地上，回敬她一个胳肢呢？

en.t: He could not decide whether to keep holding the lamp as he was, or set it down and tickle her back.

units.source_text: 可惜，还没等想清楚就要逼着他选择，他踌躇了。

en.t: Unfortunately, before he could think it through, he was forced to choose, and he hesitated.

units.source_text: 结果，“保持现状”获胜，他还是把灯拿在手里，连自己也不知道有何意义的浅笑，使他的脸僵住了。

en.t: In the end, maintaining the status quo won out; he kept the lamp in his hand, and a faint smile whose meaning even he did not understand stiffened his face.

units.source_text: 女人又抓起铁铲，他步履蹒跚地朝她走过去，女人的身影，映在沙墙上，他逐步靠近，那身影便布满了整个沙墙。

en.t: The woman picked up the iron shovel again, and he staggered toward her; her shadow was cast on the wall of sand, and as he drew closer, it spread across the entire sand wall.
